about.description: PreStocks is a blockchain-based platform providing infrastructure for tokenization and on-chain financial services. It enables users to access and trade diverse digital assets through decentralized protocols.
about.registryInfo: PreStocks (Pre IPO Tokens Ltd, BVI) tokenizes pre-IPO private-company equity, providing onchain liquidity for shares of unicorns and growth-stage companies (SpaceX, OpenAI, Stripe, etc.) backed 1:1 by share-purchase agreements held in special-purpose vehicles.

fees.revenueNotes: PreStocks earns origination fees on share-purchase deal-flow, mint/redeem spreads on primary issuance, and a performance fee on terminal exit (IPO/acquisition).
